reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: validateDataColumnSidecar (L586-716) calls verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:352-366) which only validates kzg_commitments.len > 0 and array consistency, lacking the epoch-specific max_blobs_per_block check present in validateBeaconBlock (L383-388: `len(blob_kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch).MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK`). This is a clear spec deviation per 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json (L227-242). However, severity downgraded from HIGH to Medium: the target (nimbus-eth2) has ~18% network share per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json client_diversity data, which falls between Medium threshold (>5%) and High threshold (>33%). The spec violation enables resource exhaustion attacks but affects only one client implementation.
